snippet.title: Her Revenge - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the announcement trailer for Her Revenge, a first-person psychological horror experience developed by Sibghat Games and Sajjad Chandioset. The game is set entirely inside a sealed apartment building. You are thrown into the center of a massive, terrifying misunderstanding. Discover the horrific truth of Grandma's story, and find a way to stop her from finding you. You must first find out what happened and then END the madness. There's a secret room somewhere in the apartment, which will answer all your questions. Silence is Survival. You are not alone. Her Revenge is launching on PC (Steam) in September 2026.
